column1: # The fork's extra zh-hans entries for interface text this fork adds on top of upstream
# PdfCraft (the activation gate, the password-free security removal, the OCR languages the
# Tesseract engine reads). Clean-room: written from the plain meaning of the English text in
# ordinary computing vocabulary, like every entry in craft-i18n; no other product's
# localisation was consulted or copied. Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 like the repository.
# The Kylin workflow appends this file to the pinned craft-i18n checkout's
# locales/zh-hans/pdfcraft.tsv before CRAFT_I18N_DIR embeds it; every line here was checked
# absent from that checkout first, so appending creates no duplicate keys.
# Columns, separated by a TAB: context <TAB> English source text <TAB> translation

column3: 无密码解除安全性设置

column2: Cannot read a hardware identifier on this machine; activation is not possible.
column3: 无法读取这台机器的硬件标识，无法激活。

column2: Activation is free: it only tells the author that this installation exists. The code stays on this machine until you send it yourself.

column2: Your machine code — send it to the author:
column3: 你的机器码 —— 请把它发送给作者：

column2: Paste the activation code you received:
four to six words joined by -
column3: 四到六个词，用 - 连接

column2: To store the activation, run this in a terminal and restart:
column3: 如需保存激活，请在终端运行以下命令，然后重新启动：
